newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bital to issue new subordinated bonds. [corrected 00:48 gmt 10/9]
newsitem.headline: Bital to issue new subordinated bonds. [corrected 00:48 gmt 10/9]

text.p: (Corrects company name from Bitel to Bital)
Grupo Financiero Bital said that it will issue subordinated bonds worth between 360 and 400 million pesos later this year.
The debt issue was approved on Friday.
The financial group also approved another tranche of the financial group's portfolio sale to the government's bank support fund, Fobaproa.
The tranche will total 1.5 billion pesos.
